rev_semantics.WORKTREE: read the receipt file directly (authored fixtures); bind_rev is then required and is the revision the tool identity binds to
rev_semantics.PENDING-L1: placeholder for a receipt that is not committed yet; evaluates as PENDING (could-not-evaluate, exit 2, never credit)

bind_rev_semantics: Revision whose <tool> bytes the receipt attests; defaults to rev. A declared value other than rev must equal the receipt's own measured_commit and marks a before-state receipt (it deliberately ran the older tool). Leaving it unset on a receipt whose measured_commit tool differs from rev is STALE.

expect_semantics.ok: provenance complete, measured_commit an ancestor of the read revision, tool bytes equal at measured_commit (or tool_rev) and after it
expect_semantics.MISSING_PROVENANCE: no tool_sha256 and/or measured_commit in the receipt
expect_semantics.SHA_MISMATCH: tool_sha256 is not the digest of the tool at measured_commit (or tool_rev)
expect_semantics.STALE: internally consistent receipt that attests a superseded tool at the claimed revision (R17-V1/V2)
expect_semantics.NOT_ANCESTOR: measured_commit is not an ancestor of the revision the claim reads at
expect_semantics.PRODUCER_MISMATCH: the receipt's own tool= token names a producer the claim does not
